title: Argmax Flows and Multinomial Diffusion: Learning Categorical Distributions

openAccessPdf.disclaimer: Notice: Paper or abstract available at https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.05379, which is subject to the license by the author or copyright owner provided with this content. Please go to the source to verify the license and copyright information for your use.

tldr.text: This paper introduces two extensions of flows and diffusion for categorical data such as language or image segmentation: Argmax Flows and Multinomial Diffusion and demonstrates that this method outperforms existing dequantization approaches on text modelling and modelling on image segmentation maps in log-likelihood.
